name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label that appears beside its trigger on hover or on keyboard focus. Wraps @base-ui/react/tooltip and adds the one thing Base UI 1.6 does not emit: the `role="tooltip"` / `aria-describedby` pair.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/tooltip

Installed to `components/ui/tooltip.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/tooltip

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
